question.q: Read: 'Evan checked his bicycle brakes before riding in the rain, even though he had repaired them last week.' What is the best inference?
question.correct: Evan wanted to confirm the brakes still worked safely.
wrong: Evan knew that the brakes had failed again.
The bicycle had never been repaired.
Evan intended to avoid riding his bicycle entirely.
question.exp: The precaution suggests he was checking safety. Nothing in the sentence confirms a new brake failure or an intention to cancel the ride.
